title: Human-directed catalog reorganization and public navigation
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's explicit approval to implement the discussed catalog reorganization and resume it. Merge programming environments, move storage to architecture, retain software sustainability, separate three workload domains into needs and evaluation, preserve historical IDs and evidence, and update bilingual public navigation. This authorizes editorial restructuring, not new scientific claims, Consensus acceptance, production automation, procurement decisions, or disclosure of private material.
